page_title: CRY 2-1 BHA | Crystal Palace v Brighton 05/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+14' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+14' The linesman points to the corner flag, Brighton are going to take it.

90+13' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) was close to scoring a goal after unleashing a first-time effort from inside the six-yard box. The ball was aimed towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper read it well and pulled off a brilliant save to thwart the attempt.
90+12' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
90+10' Simon Adingra (Brighton) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
90+9' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
90+7' Ben Chilwell (Crystal Palace) attempts to score from a mid-range free kick, but he curls his effort a few inches over the crossbar.
90+6' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) is awarded a yellow card and sent off by Anthony Taylor because it's his second one today.
90+5' The attendance is 24564.
90+5' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) fires a volley towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but the ball goes well wide of the right post.
90+5' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Mats Wieffer (Brighton). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
90+3' The substitution is prepared. Mats Wieffer (Brighton) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jack Hinshelwood.
90+2' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) missed a great opportunity! He jumped for a cross and headed towards goal from the penalty spot, but the ball sailed well wide of the left post!
90' 12 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) receives a yellow card from Anthony Taylor and because it's his second he will have an early bath.
90' Joel Ward comes onto the pitch because Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
86' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
84' Crystal Palace take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

83' Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Crystal Palace.
82' Oliver Glasner decides to make a substitution. Eberechi Eze will be replaced by Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace).
82' Substitution. Adam Wharton walks off the pitch and Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) comes on as a substitute.
81' Substitution. Pervis Estupinan is replaced by Yasin Ayari (Brighton).
80' Solly March (Brighton) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
80' Solly March (Brighton) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
80' Simon Adingra (Brighton) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
78' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) is awarded a second yellow by Anthony Taylor and subsequently dismisses him with a red one.
75' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) sends a long ball forward to Simon Adingra, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
74' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) touches the ball with his hand.
73' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
72' We are about to witness a substitution. Brajan Gruda (Brighton) is replacing Diego Gomez.
72' Substitution. Solly March (Brighton) in, Yankuba Minteh out.
71' Joao Pedro (Brighton) tries to find Diego Gomez, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
69' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) went to the ground quite willingly. The referee is firm and issues Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) a deserved yellow card.
68' Oliver Glasner has decided to substitute Jean-Philippe Mateta and he is replaced by Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace).
65' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) sends a long through ball to Joao Pedro, but he fails to control it properly and loses it to one of the defending players.
64' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
63' A substitution has been made. Tyrick Mitchell is replaced by Ben Chilwell (Crystal Palace).
63' Here is a change. Matt O'Riley is going off and Fabian Hurzeler gives the last tactical orders to Joao Pedro (Brighton).
63' Substitution. Kaoru Mitoma makes his way off the pitch and Simon Adingra (Brighton) comes on as his replacement.
61' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) sends a long ball forward to Kaoru Mitoma, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
60' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) sends a cross into the box, but Bart Verbruggen comes off his line to gather the ball.
57' It's like he was asking for a caution. Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) receives a yellow card.
55' 2 - 1 Goal! Eberechi Eze passes the ball to Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Bart Verbruggen couldn't do anything about it. 2:1.
54' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on. Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
54' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.

52' The game is interrupted now, Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on. Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
51' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) makes a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
49' Diego Gomez (Brighton) attempts to feed Yankuba Minteh with a chip pass, but Dean Henderson reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
47' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Anthony Taylor has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) finds his teammate inside the box with a sweet pass. However, Ismaila Sarr wasn't able to finish and lost the ball.
42' Matt O'Riley (Brighton) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
41' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) trips an opposition player and Anthony Taylor signals a foul. It's a free kick to Brighton in a dangerous position.
39' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
36' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) threads a pass through to Diego Gomez, but Dean Henderson breaks up the move.

35' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Tyrick Mitchell was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
34' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and it's Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
31' 1 - 1 What a goal! Yankuba Minteh plays it to Danny Welbeck (Brighton), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Dean Henderson into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
29' The ball is cleared after Matt O'Riley (Brighton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
26' The free kick is delivered by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
25' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
24' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Crystal Palace are awarded a free kick.
24' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) sends a long cross over to Danny Welbeck, but Dean Henderson comes forward to gather the ball.
23' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Bart Verbruggen intercepts the ball.
23' 3:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The current number of shots on goal is 2:2.
21' It looks like Matt O'Riley (Brighton) saw red with that tackle. Anthony Taylor won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
20' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
15' Diego Gomez (Brighton) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
14' Matt O'Riley (Brighton) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

13' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Dean Henderson! Danny Welbeck (Brighton) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the bottom right corner, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Dean Henderson. What a save!
13' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
12' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
10' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) is about to take a corner kick.

9' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Bart Verbruggen leaps like a salmon to deny him. Crystal Palace will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
8' A lofted cross from Lewis Dunk (Brighton) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
6' A pass from Matt O'Riley (Brighton) is intercepted by Dean Henderson and the move breaks down.
5' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) wastes no time in going for goal after collecting a rebound, but his long-range effort is comfortably blocked by a defender.

3' 1 - 0 Goal! Great play by Eberechi Eze releases Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into the top right corner. 1:0.
2' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
1' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) picks out Tyrick Mitchell with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
